name: Church, Letters, and Hope Quiz Bank
summary: Reusable quiz questions from the Church, Letters, and Hope lesson pack.
kid_summary: Questions from Church, Letters, and Hope.

questions.question: What did Jesus promise His disciples?
This lesson teaches that jesus sends His followers to make disciples and promises to be with them.
Who came at Pentecost?
This lesson teaches that god gives the Holy Spirit and gathers people from many nations.
In whose name was the man healed?
This lesson teaches that jesus' name brings hope, and God's people can notice those in need.
Who explained Scripture to the Ethiopian official?
This lesson teaches that god can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus.
Who met Saul on the road?
This lesson teaches that jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission.
Who did Peter visit?
This lesson teaches that the good news of Jesus is for every nation and people group.
What did Paul and Silas do in prison?
This lesson teaches that god can bring worship and witness even in hard places.
Who grows this fruit in God's people?
This lesson teaches that the Holy Spirit grows Christlike character in God's people.
What sword is named in the armor of God?
This lesson teaches that god gives His people truth, faith, salvation, Scripture, and prayer for spiritual strength.
What does Paul say love is?
This lesson teaches that love matters because God calls His people to patient, humble, faithful care.
What does God promise to make new?
This lesson teaches that god promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear.
